name: MAI-Thinking-1
short: Microsoft AI's first in-house reasoning model — ~1T-total / 35B-active sparse MoE on MAI-Base-1, trained from scratch on commercially licensed data with no third-party distillation. AIME 2025 97%, LiveCodeBench v6 87.7%, SWE-bench Verified 73.5%, GPQA Diamond 84.2%.
pricingNote: $2.00 in per 1M; output reported as $8.00 (AIHubMix) or $10.00 — Microsoft publishes no public rate card
